newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, but off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, but off early lows.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Monday, but were off early lows as the index recovered towards the close on short-covering and buying of select blue chips, dealers said.

"The index recovered slightly on short-covering, but the sentiment is mixed," dealer Ali Asghar said. "Investors are on the sidelines as they wait for new economic measuers by the caretaker government."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 8.78 points, or 0.59 percent, to end at 1,583.96. Losers led gainers 180 to 66. Hub Power fell 0.45 rupees to 34.30. - Amir Zia 9221-5685192

Bank of Punjab fell 0.75 to 17 rupees and Askari Bank 0.45 to 24.25. Gadoon Textile fell 1.80 to 34, Dewan Salman Fibre 0.50 to 37.60, Hub Power Co 0.30 to 34.30 and Pakistan State Oil 5.0 to 380. PTCL rose 0.10 to 32.40. FFC Jordan Fertilizer fell 0.30 to 14.30, Fauji Fertilizer rose 0.50 to 82.50 and ICI Pakistan 0.15 to 19.90.
